# LangChain RAG — Bugbot Review Checklist

Use this checklist when reviewing changes to the scaffold or generated RAG apps.

## Banned APIs (must fail convention checker)

<!-- banned-apis:begin (generated by scripts/sync_conventions.py) -->
- [ ] No `from langchain.chains import ...`
- [ ] No `from langchain.chat_models import ...`
- [ ] No `from langchain.memory import ...`
- [ ] No `langchain_classic` imports
- [ ] No `.run()` on chains — use `.invoke()` with LCEL
- [ ] No `initialize_agent(...)`
<!-- banned-apis:end -->

## Required patterns

- [ ] Chains use LCEL: `prompt | llm | StrOutputParser()`
- [ ] LLM: `langchain_openai.ChatOpenAI`
- [ ] Embeddings: `langchain_voyageai.VoyageAIEmbeddings` (manual, client-side)
- [ ] Vector store: `langchain_mongodb.MongoDBAtlasVectorSearch`
- [ ] Memory: `RunnableWithMessageHistory`, not `ConversationBufferMemory`

## Project structure

- [ ] New loaders live in `ingestion/loader.py`
- [ ] Chunking/embed/store logic stays in `ingestion/pipeline.py`
- [ ] Retriever setup stays in `retrieval/vector_store.py`
- [ ] Prompts stay in `chains/rag.py`
- [ ] `cli.py` delegates — no core business logic added there

## Tests

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated in `tests/unit/` for behavior changes
- [ ] Atlas/API-dependent tests use `@pytest.mark.integration`
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/check_conventions.py` passes

## Dependencies

- [ ] No new dependencies outside the approved stack without explicit approval
- [ ] `pyproject.toml` floor pins preserved (`>=`, not unpinned wildcards)

## Secrets and boundaries

- [ ] No `.env` or API keys committed
- [ ] No code copied from sibling repos — use official LangChain, MongoDB, and Voyage AI docs only
- [ ] LangChain docs accessed via the `docs-langchain` MCP server, not copy-paste from web sources
